assign.outcome:
**Twenty-two notebook photos are now twenty-two pages you can browse.** [/notes/](/notes/) is a wall of picture cards. Each page is the photo upright, what it says word for word, what it points at on this site as a linked list, and the thing built to match.

![](shot.png)

**The eleven things built.** A [1920 to 3413 calculator](/notes/scale-1920-to-3413/) that solves the note's own sum. A [spread with an optional anchor](/notes/visual-context/). A [drop target](/notes/drop-target-ux/) on `ext/Draggable` showing all four moments of a drag. A [nine-way anchor picker](/notes/anchor-point-optional/). A [daily checklist and beat strip](/notes/record-long-cut-to-60s/). A [rig constraint table](/notes/shotgun-or-lav/). An [access matrix](/notes/meeting-notes-are-ip/). A [fan-out](/notes/one-video-everywhere/), a [sign-up flow](/notes/sign-up-flow/), a [claim shape](/notes/topic-dbs-and-claims/), [three promo drafts](/notes/what-is-openmike/), a [targeting grid](/notes/right-people-not-many/), [two boxes](/notes/strengths-and-weaknesses/), [six rebuilt wireframes](/notes/layouts-need-fit/), a [switcher](/notes/switch-or-transition/), [eight more wireframes](/notes/notebook-cooked/), a [price card](/notes/each-meme-is-a-community/), a [four-step level flow](/notes/levels-and-points/), a [swipe rail](/notes/personal-specs/), a [tower by floor](/notes/basketball-tower/), an [edit-mode demo](/notes/edge-selection/) and the [column arithmetic](/notes/parallel-generation/).

**Reuse, not repetition.** `public/notes/note.js` holds `NotesNote` — the photo and the card — so each page is only its own words. `notes.css` is three rules. [readme.md](/notes/readme.md) says how to add the next one.

**Privacy.** Two spreads had a home address, utility account numbers, a password hint and apartment logistics on the right-hand page: their image is cropped to the LEFT page and that half is not transcribed. Third parties are initials on three pages; one private moral list is not re-typed. All seven say so in a line and link the original, which opens only on a local checkout.

**Proved.** Every page and the index at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440: zero console errors, no sideways scroll, and every href resolves (60+ urls probed). Photo capped to a fold so a note is one screen at every width.

**Left, with reasons.** One line is owed in `framework/styles/css-scopes.txt` — `notes-   /notes/` — outside this task's write fence. Images 023-038 belong to notes-pages-2.
